Theorem
[Parallel Transport Determines Covariant Differentiation] ↗ cor:parallel-transport-piecewise-smooth-curves 1. ch4:4.34

For a smooth curve $\gamma \colon I\to M$, a smooth vector field $V$ along it, and $t_0\in I$, \begin{equation} D_tV(t_0)=\lim _{t_1\to t_0} \frac{P_{t_1t_0}^\gamma V(t_1)-V(t_0)}{t_1-t_0}. \tag {4.24} \end{equation}

Proof

\sketch Write $V(t)=V^i(t)E_i(t)$ in a parallel frame. Equation (4.23) gives $D_tV(t_0)=\dot V^i(t_0)E_i(t_0)$, while

\[ P_{t_1t_0}^\gamma V(t_1)=V^i(t_1)E_i(t_0). \]

The difference quotient has the same limit.

□
